name: I’ll Breakup With Her, It’ll Hert
source:
At what point do you end it?  Not all relationships are meant to be.  Relationships aren’t always about getting together.  There are stories about separating: suddenly, lovingly, stupidly, angrily, sadly, traitorously, disgustingly, happily and... painfully. 

Dwywen and Tanisha have been together for a long time but the Main Character, Dwywen, realizes she doesn’t truly love Tanisha. She’s been living a lie but you decide when to let the truth out and end the pain. 

How long do you want to persevere? Will you end it now or see how far it can go? 

[From [url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/ill-breakup-with-her-itll-hert]Itch.io[/url]]
